tur28-2: A sideways curve of the spine that also twists around its own axis. It most often appears in adolescence, in a form with no known cause (idiopathic), and it is usually painless. Because the curve progresses most during the rapid growth spurt of adolescence, spotting it early matters. In this guide we explain curve types, how curves are measured on X-rays, when curves progress and how treatment has changed over time, showing research findings and clinical experience separately.
